name: Dal tadka

steps.text: Pressure cook both dals with turmeric, tomato and salt, 4 whistles.
steps.cue: The dal collapses into a creamy mash when stirred, with no hard bits.

steps.text: Heat ghee, fry cumin, garlic, onion and chilli powder until golden.
steps.cue: The cumin sizzles, the garlic is golden and the onion is soft. Pour at once.

steps.text: Pour tadka over dal, simmer 3 minutes, add coriander.
steps.cue: The surface shimmers with spiced oil and the dal pours like thick soup.
steps.tip: Add hot water a splash at a time if it is too thick.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze for 3 months. Dal thickens as it sits: loosen with hot water and refresh with a fresh tadka.
